matchContextNotes: Measured 2026-10-14 on the 719 bodies whose DSS names Amphora in Spansh's dump (one species, so the genus is the species): metal-rich 719; airless 718 (one hot thin silicate vapour); volcanism major on all 719 (metallic magma 427, silicate vapour geysers 201, rocky magma 91), never minor or none; 955-2,669 K (5-95 %: 1,010-1,530 K, median 1,125 K); 0.04-3.96 g; 1-2 biological signals. The 7 EDDN ScanOrganic finds of the year agree (all major, 1,029-1,359 K).

Star: main star A 696, B 12, F 6, neutron 1, unknown 4; an A or B star somewhere in the system on 715 of 715 with a star on record, so the gate reads any star in the system. The body's own host is the A star on fewer than half (K 136, G 47, M 35, F 31 are hosts); parent_star is the text shown for it; the gate itself is in src/shared/hostStarGates.ts.

Companion bodies: one of the listed classes is in 709 of 719 systems (the other 10 hold 1-15 known bodies). Gas giant with water-based life is in 684 and the only listed one in 539; Earth-like world in 35 (alone in 23), ammonia world 30, water giant 48, gas giant with ammonia-based life 75. Earth-like or ammonia world alone would hold 65 of 719.

Against the DSS-mapped airless metal-rich landable bodies around an A or B star with a listed companion (1,020), major volcanism keeps 900 and every Amphora body: 708 of 900 carry it (78.7 %), and 188 of the other 192 carry Anemone instead. Main star A: 689 of 695 (99.1 %); main star B: 12 of 194 (Anemone takes the rest).

authorNotes.temperature_constraints: 950 K and up (measured 955-2,669 K on 719 DSS bodies)
special_rules: An A or B star in the system (main star A on 97 %)
Requires specific system body presence (at least one listed type; gas giant with water-based life on 95 %)
Only found on airless metal-rich planets with major volcanism (metallic magma, silicate vapour geysers or rocky magma)
